skill.name: web-research-assistant
skill.description: Web research assistant that uses the BrowserAct MCP service to search the web, collect source snippets, and generate research reports.
skill.summary: Searches the web through BrowserAct and formats cited research reports.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs intended third-party web research through BrowserAct and writes optional reports, but it also promotes bypassing blocked access, geofencing, paywalls, and verification challenges. Most markdown backtick and hidden-directory findings are false positives, while network calls, token handling, user-specified file writes, chat-based key collection, and circumvention language remain security concerns.

remediation.issue: Access restriction and paywall circumvention language
remediation.suggestion: Remove claims about bypassing blocked sites, paywalls, geofencing, reCAPTCHA, and verification challenges. Limit the skill to compliant public web research.
Use environment variables or a secure secret store only. Do not ask users to paste API keys into prompts or chat messages.
Constrain report output to a safe workspace path, check for existing files, or require explicit overwrite confirmation.
Document that queries and source-processing requests are sent to BrowserAct. Add consent guidance for sensitive or confidential research topics.
Use one credential variable name consistently in metadata, documentation, and scripts to prevent unsafe troubleshooting and secret disclosure.

content.value_statement: Manual web research can fail when browsing tools cannot reach current sources. This skill searches through BrowserAct and formats source-backed research reports.
actual_capabilities: Sends a search query to the BrowserAct MCP endpoint.
Supports Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo engine options.
Filters results by content type and time range.
Extracts titles, URLs, snippets, statistics, and source counts.
Generates markdown or JSON research output.
Can save a generated report to a user-specified file path.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct token in the environment before use.
Sends research queries to a third-party BrowserAct service.
Extracted key facts are limited by the returned snippets.
Saved reports can overwrite writable files if the output path is unsafe.

use_cases.description: Gather recent source snippets and links for a focused research question.

use_cases.title: Market Scan Drafting
use_cases.description: Collect search results for market trends, competitors, or industry updates.

use_cases.title: Citation Collection
use_cases.description: Create a starting list of source titles, URLs, snippets, and statistics.

prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with content and time filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for recent news about semiconductor supply chains from the past week. Return source titles, links, and key statistics.

prompt_templates.title: Comparative Source Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Research three sources about remote work productivity. Compare the claims, note conflicts, and cite the source URLs.

prompt_templates.prompt: Research enterprise AI governance frameworks, include source snippets and statistics, and save a markdown report in the project workspace.

output_examples.input: Research AI regulation updates from the past month.
output_examples.output: A markdown report with an executive summary, source list, snippets, statistics, and recommendations for follow-up verification.

output_examples.input: Find recent market data about electric vehicle charging networks.
output_examples.output: A source-backed research summary that lists relevant links, extracted numeric claims, and notes where publication dates should be checked.

output_examples.input: Collect sources for a competitor landscape review.
output_examples.output: A structured set of search results with titles, URLs, snippets, and a short summary of how many sources were found.

best_practices: Use specific queries with clear entities, dates, and location constraints.
Avoid sending confidential topics or secrets to the external search service.
Verify important claims against primary sources before publishing conclusions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to bypass paywalls, access controls, or verification challenges.
Do not paste API keys into chat; configure credentials through environment variables.
Do not save reports to broad or sensitive filesystem paths.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It sends web research queries to BrowserAct and formats returned sources into research reports.

faq.question: Does it require an API token?
faq.answer: Yes. The script expects a BrowserAct MCP token in the environment before it can run.

faq.question: Can it save reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can write markdown or JSON output to a path supplied by the caller.

faq.question: Does it browse locally?
faq.answer: No. It sends requests to the BrowserAct MCP endpoint and processes the returned results.

faq.question: What should users avoid?
faq.answer: Users should avoid confidential queries, unsafe output paths, and attempts to bypass access restrictions.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill environments.
